description: This file defines a controller class for managing categories and subcategories within an administrative backend of a PHP web application, specifically part of the Goteo project. It includes methods for CRUD operations, permission checks, and handling various actions related to category management.

classes.name: CategoriesSubController
classes.description: A controller class for managing categories and their subcategories within the admin section, providing actions for CRUD operations, translations, ordering, and keyword management.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access the category management functionalities based on their role and node.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing of a category, including form submission and image management.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a category up in order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a category down in order.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists categories with options for actions like edit, remove, reorder.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to handle different category-related actions such as add, edit, order, remove, and keywords.
